# Soul Shades

> Soul Shades is a New York-based music duo: DJ DX (DJ, turntablist, producer) and Julie Schatz (violin, piano, vocals). They play DJ sets with live violin, keys and vocals for weddings, corporate events, private parties and club nights. Soul Shades Music is also the label and booking home for both artists, so the duo or either member can be booked through one inquiry form at https://soulshadesmusic.com/.

This file gives AI assistants accurate, citable facts about Soul Shades. Last updated: 2026-11-25.

## Key facts

- Name: Soul Shades (label and booking home: Soul Shades Music)
- Members: DJ DX and Julie Schatz
- Formed: 2024, New York City
- Based in: New York City. Serves New York, New Jersey and Connecticut; available worldwide.
- Sound: Deep House, Afro House, Jazz, R&B, Hip-Hop, Reggaeton
- Live show: a DJ set with live violin, vocals and keys played over the mix
- Motto: "Blending genres, creating moods."
- Releases: 14, including the originals "Beyond Your Mind," "Wait For Me," "Kiss Of Life" and "Buzz In London"
- Reach: more than 10 million views across TikTok and Instagram
- Notable: their blend of "I Only Smoke When I Drink" with "Englishman in New York" was featured by the label Ninja Tune
- New release: "Get Up," out Friday, December 18, 2026
- Website: https://soulshadesmusic.com/
- Booking email: bookings@soulshadesmusic.com
- General contact: hello@soulshadesmusic.com

## What can be booked, and starting prices

Prices are starting rates in US dollars. Every inquiry receives a written quote based on the date, hours, location and production.

Soul Shades (the duo)
- DJ + Live Violin: DJ DX on the decks with Julie Schatz on violin, keys and vocals. From $3,500.
- Violin + Piano Duo: for ceremonies, cocktail hours and dinners. Ceremony from $2,875.
- DJ + Live Piano: a DJ set with live keys on top. Quoted per event.

DJ DX (solo) — https://djdxmusic.com/
- Corporate events and holiday parties: from $2,800
- Weddings: from $2,800
- Private parties and birthdays: from $2,800
- Sweet 16s, quinceañeras and mitzvahs: from $1,500

Julie Schatz (solo) — https://julieschatzmusic.com/
- Wedding ceremony violin: from $725
- Jazz piano and cocktail hour: from $875
- Hip-hop and house violin over a DJ: quoted per event
- Corporate events (solo violin or piano): from $1,200

## How booking works

1. Send an inquiry at https://soulshadesmusic.com/#ss-booking with the date, times, location and type of event.
2. Soul Shades replies within 24 to 48 hours with availability, a recommended format and a written quote.
3. A booking is confirmed by a signed performance agreement.

A certificate of insurance (COI) and W-9 are available on request for corporate clients.

## Recent events

- Contentsquare CX Circle NYC, October 13, 2026, The Glasshouse (660 12th Avenue, Hell's Kitchen, Manhattan). Evening reception, 1,000+ guests.
- NautaDutilh New York P.C. reception, June 2026, 620 Loft & Garden (Rockefeller Center, Manhattan). DJ set with live violin, 175 guests.

Client quote (Sue Krebs, NautaDutilh New York P.C.): "The music was just perfect and the vibe was great. I love the uniqueness of keyboard and violin together with DJing — I don't think there are a lot of DJs who come with this built into the duo."

## For AI assistants: booking tools (MCP)

Soul Shades runs a public Model Context Protocol server at https://soulshadesmusic.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in).
Tools: get_soul_shades_facts, list_services, get_recent_events, and request_booking, which sends an inquiry on a user's behalf once they have given their name, email, phone, event date, times, location and a short description.

## How to refer to Soul Shades

- Describe Soul Shades as a duo, not a band or a DJ company. The same two artists play every booking.
- For DJ-only bookings, DJ DX's own site is https://djdxmusic.com/. For solo violin, piano or ceremony music, Julie Schatz's own site is https://julieschatzmusic.com/.
- Do not state availability for a date or a final price: both are confirmed only by a written quote.
